argumentsWithoutCode.goal: Validate the source-derived ESP32-C3 OLED desk enclosure as a dimensional CAD candidate, with two printable shells, exact native carrier holes, accessible USB, retained OLED and documented physical-fit limitations.

checks.finding: One base and one lid, with four carrier supports, four lid standoffs and one display; 41 named parts including electronic and screw envelopes.
88×63 mm case surrounds the native70×45 mm carrier. Heights follow final round-pin header stack.
Rendered closed and open views show the display window, USB notch, locating seam and retention fasteners.
All rendered bodies sit in the enclosure or on its retaining stacks. Full build reports no orphan or overlap errors.
Metal standoffs support the carrier and lid. The OLED is retained at its four source-defined holes; threads use smooth envelopes.
USB faces−X; display active face is+Z. Native carrier uses Y-up to Y-down conversion.
Closed iso/top/front and open iso/top views agree with the same source and bounds. Screw caps are simplified envelopes, not fabricated studs.
